SlopClean · In development

SlopClean: photo metadata remover

See what a photo reveals, and remove it. Nothing uploaded.

Open now

SlopClean has these main features: Shows GPS, camera, serial and date fields; Removes them without re-encoding the picture. It opens JPEG, PNG, WebP, TIFF.

In development: some features listed below may not be finished yet.

What you can do with SlopClean

  • Remove EXIF data from a photo
  • Remove the location from a photo
  • See the hidden data in a photo
